snippet.title: Animalkind Early Access Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
✨Wishlist Animalkind here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2997840/Animalkind/

Animalkind is an inviting open-world town-building game where you play as an intelligent, aww-dorable animal who discovers an ancient mech. Animalkind is entering Steam Early Access on March 30, 2026!

✨Discord: discord.gg/animalkind
✨Our website: animalkind.gg
